butter_chicken.key_ingredients: Chicken, tomato, butter, cream, cashew, kasuri methi, spices
butter_chicken.rationale: Chicken in a butter and cream gravy.

chicken_tikka.key_ingredients: Boneless chicken, yoghurt, ginger-garlic, chilli, garam masala

chicken_tikka_masala.key_ingredients: Chicken tikka, tomato, onion, cream, spices
chicken_tikka_masala.rationale: Grilled chicken in a creamy tomato gravy.

tandoori_chicken.key_ingredients: Chicken on the bone, yoghurt, Kashmiri chilli, ginger-garlic, lemon

chicken_biryani.key_ingredients: Basmati rice, chicken, yoghurt, fried onion, saffron, ghee, whole spices

mutton_biryani.key_ingredients: Basmati rice, goat meat, yoghurt, fried onion, saffron, ghee, mint
mutton_biryani.rationale: Rice layered with goat or lamb.

rogan_josh.key_ingredients: Lamb or goat, yoghurt, Kashmiri chilli, fennel, dry ginger

mutton_curry.key_ingredients: Goat meat, onion, tomato, ginger-garlic, garam masala
mutton_curry.rationale: Goat meat on the bone in gravy.

keema.key_ingredients: Minced goat or lamb, onion, tomato, peas, spices

seekh_kebab.key_ingredients: Minced lamb or chicken, onion, coriander, green chilli, spices
seekh_kebab.rationale: Minced meat grilled on a skewer.

fish_curry.key_ingredients: Fish, coconut or mustard, tamarind, chilli, curry leaves
fish_curry.rationale: Fish simmered in gravy (includes Bengali maach jhol).

fish_fry.key_ingredients: Fish steaks or fillets, chilli, turmeric, rice flour or semolina crust

prawn_curry.key_ingredients: Prawns, coconut milk, onion, tomato, kokum or tamarind

egg_curry.key_ingredients: Boiled eggs, onion, tomato, ginger-garlic, spices
egg_curry.rationale: Boiled eggs in gravy. Egg counts as non-vegetarian in the Indian convention (FSSAI brown mark), which this taxonomy follows.

chicken_65.key_ingredients: Chicken, yoghurt, red chilli, curry leaves, rice flour

palak_paneer.key_ingredients: Spinach puree, paneer, onion, garlic, cream
palak_paneer.rationale: Paneer is a fresh milk cheese.

paneer_butter_masala.rationale: Paneer in a butter and cream gravy.

kadai_paneer.key_ingredients: Paneer, capsicum, onion, tomato, coriander seed
kadai_paneer.rationale: Paneer is a fresh milk cheese.

paneer_tikka.key_ingredients: Paneer cubes, yoghurt, capsicum, onion, spices
paneer_tikka.rationale: Grilled paneer in a yoghurt marinade.

dal_makhani.key_ingredients: Whole black lentils, kidney beans, butter, cream, tomato
dal_makhani.rationale: Butter and cream are defining ingredients, not garnish.

dal_tadka.key_ingredients: Yellow lentils, onion, tomato, cumin, garlic, ghee tempering
dal_tadka.rationale: The lentils are plant-based but the tempering is traditionally ghee, which cannot be seen in a photograph. Vegan only when made with oil.

kadhi_pakoda.key_ingredients: Yoghurt, gram flour, gram-flour fritters, turmeric

malai_kofta.key_ingredients: Paneer and potato dumplings, cream, cashew, tomato
malai_kofta.rationale: Paneer dumplings in a cream gravy.

navrattan_korma.key_ingredients: Mixed vegetables, paneer, cream, cashew, dried fruit

naan.key_ingredients: Refined flour, yoghurt, milk, yeast, butter
naan.animal_byproduct: Dairy (yoghurt and milk in the dough, butter on top)
naan.rationale: Naan dough is made with yoghurt or milk.

masala_dosa.key_ingredients: Fermented rice and urad dal batter, potato filling, mustard seed, ghee or butter
masala_dosa.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee or butter on the griddle)
masala_dosa.rationale: Batter and filling are plant-based but restaurants commonly cook it in ghee or butter. Vegan only when made with oil.

pav_bhaji.key_ingredients: Mashed mixed vegetables, pav bhaji masala, bread rolls, butter

gulab_jamun.key_ingredients: Khoya (milk solids), flour, sugar syrup, cardamom

ras_malai.key_ingredients: Chhena discs, sweetened thickened milk, saffron, pistachio

jalebi.key_ingredients: Refined flour batter, yoghurt, sugar syrup, ghee
jalebi.animal_byproduct: Dairy (yoghurt in the batter, often fried in ghee)
jalebi.rationale: Batter is fermented with yoghurt and it is commonly fried in ghee.

gajar_ka_halwa.key_ingredients: Grated carrot, milk, ghee, sugar, khoya, nuts
gajar_ka_halwa.rationale: Carrot cooked down in milk and ghee.

kheer.rationale: Rice pudding cooked in milk (includes phirni).

lassi.key_ingredients: Yoghurt, water or milk, sugar or salt

chana_masala.key_ingredients: Chickpeas, onion, tomato, ginger, amchur, spices, oil
chana_masala.rationale: Chickpeas in an oil-based onion-tomato gravy. Plant-based as traditionally made; some kitchens finish with ghee.

aloo_gobi.rationale: Dry vegetable dish cooked in oil.

bhindi_masala.key_ingredients: Okra, onion, tomato, amchur, spices, oil

baingan_bharta.key_ingredients: Fire-roasted aubergine, onion, tomato, garlic, mustard oil
baingan_bharta.rationale: Roasted aubergine mashed with oil and aromatics.

idli.key_ingredients: Fermented rice and urad dal batter, steamed
idli.rationale: Steamed rice-lentil cake; no fat is used in cooking. Accompanying chutney and sambar are also normally plant-based.

poha.key_ingredients: Flattened rice, onion, mustard seed, curry leaves, peanuts, turmeric, oil

samosa.key_ingredients: Refined flour pastry, potato, peas, cumin, oil for frying
samosa.rationale: Potato-filled pastry fried in oil. Some shops use ghee in the dough.

chapati.rationale: Plain unleavened wheat bread. Vegan as made; often brushed with ghee when served, which is usually visible as a sheen.

bhel_puri.key_ingredients: Puffed rice, sev, onion, tomato, tamarind and coriander chutneys
bhel_puri.rationale: Puffed rice tossed with chutneys; no dairy.

adhirasam.key_ingredients: Rice flour, jaggery, cardamom, sesame, deep-fried in oil or ghee
adhirasam.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee in the dough or for frying)
adhirasam.rationale: Rice and jaggery are plant-based, but ghee is commonly worked into the dough or used for frying, which a photograph cannot show. Vegan only when made entirely with oil.

aloo_matar.key_ingredients: Potato, green peas, onion, tomato, ginger, spices, oil
aloo_matar.rationale: Potato and peas in an oil-based onion-tomato gravy. Plant-based as usually made; some restaurant versions add cream or butter.

aloo_methi.key_ingredients: Potato, fresh fenugreek leaves, garlic, cumin, turmeric, oil
aloo_methi.rationale: Dry potato and fenugreek stir-fry cooked in oil.

aloo_shimla_mirch.key_ingredients: Potato, green capsicum, cumin, turmeric, amchur, oil
aloo_shimla_mirch.rationale: Dry potato and capsicum stir-fry cooked in oil.

aloo_tikki.key_ingredients: Mashed potato, peas, spices, breadcrumbs or cornflour, shallow-fried; often topped with curd and chutneys
aloo_tikki.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee on the griddle; curd topping as chaat)
aloo_tikki.rationale: The patty is plant-based, but street vendors commonly fry it in ghee and serve it as chaat with sweetened curd. Vegan only when fried in oil and served without curd.

anarsa.key_ingredients: Soaked rice flour, jaggery or sugar, poppy seeds, fried in ghee
anarsa.rationale: A rice-and-jaggery sweet traditionally fried in ghee.

ariselu.key_ingredients: Rice flour, jaggery, sesame seeds, cardamom, ghee, deep-fried
ariselu.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee in the dough, sometimes for frying)
ariselu.rationale: Rice and jaggery are plant-based, but ghee is usually added to the dough and sometimes used for frying. Vegan only when made entirely with oil.

avial.key_ingredients: Mixed vegetables, grated coconut, curd, green chilli, curry leaves, coconut oil
avial.rationale: Vegetables in a coconut paste that is soured with curd; some versions use raw mango or tamarind instead, but curd is the usual recipe.

bandar_laddu.key_ingredients: Gram-flour boondi, sugar syrup, ghee, cardamom, cashew
bandar_laddu.rationale: Boondi laddu from Bandar (Machilipatnam), made with plenty of ghee.

basundi.key_ingredients: Full-fat milk reduced with sugar, cardamom, saffron, nuts

bhatura.key_ingredients: Refined flour, yoghurt, baking soda, oil for frying
bhatura.rationale: The dough is leavened with yoghurt.

biryani.key_ingredients: Basmati rice, chicken, mutton or egg, yoghurt, fried onion, saffron, ghee, whole spices
biryani.animal_byproduct: Poultry, red meat or egg; dairy (ghee, yoghurt)
biryani.rationale: A merged class of chicken, mutton and egg biryani; every version contains meat or egg. Vegetable biryani is not part of this class.

boondi.key_ingredients: Gram-flour batter pearls, fried; sweet boondi in sugar syrup, savoury boondi spiced, sometimes in curd as raita
boondi.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee for frying sweet boondi; curd in boondi raita)
boondi.rationale: The class mixes savoury boondi (usually oil-fried and plant-based), sweet boondi (often fried in ghee) and some boondi raita in curd. Not labelled vegan because the photos cannot separate them.

chak_hao_kheer.key_ingredients: Manipuri black rice, milk, sugar, cardamom, nuts
chak_hao_kheer.rationale: Black-rice pudding cooked in milk; the photos show the purple milk kheer. Vegan only in the rarer coconut-milk version.

cham_cham.key_ingredients: Chhena (curdled milk), sugar syrup, khoya or coconut coating
cham_cham.rationale: An oval sweet made from fresh milk curd.

chhena_kheeri.rationale: Milk curd cooked in sweetened milk.

chicken_curry.key_ingredients: Chicken, onion, tomato, ginger-garlic, garam masala
chicken_curry.rationale: Chicken on the bone in gravy.

chicken_fry.key_ingredients: Chicken, red chilli, ginger-garlic, curry leaves, spices

chicken_kebab.key_ingredients: Boneless chicken, yoghurt, ginger-garlic, chilli, spices

chicken_razala.key_ingredients: Chicken, yoghurt, cashew paste, green chilli, ghee, whole spices
chicken_razala.rationale: Chicken in a pale yoghurt and cashew gravy.

chikki.key_ingredients: Peanuts or other nuts and seeds, jaggery, a little ghee
chikki.rationale: Nuts set in jaggery; many recipes add a spoon of ghee to the syrup or the tray, which a photograph cannot show. Vegan only when made without ghee.

chilli_chicken.key_ingredients: Chicken, cornflour batter, soy sauce, capsicum, onion, green chilli
chilli_chicken.rationale: Indo-Chinese fried chicken tossed in a chilli-soy sauce.

crab_curry.key_ingredients: Crab, coconut, onion, tomato, tamarind, spices

daal_baati_churma.key_ingredients: Wheat baati dipped in ghee, mixed lentil dal, churma of crushed wheat, ghee and jaggery or sugar
daal_baati_churma.rationale: The baati is soaked in ghee and the churma is bound with ghee.

daal_puri.key_ingredients: Wheat or refined flour, spiced lentil filling or lentil paste, oil or ghee
daal_puri.rationale: Lentil-stuffed fried bread; mostly plant-based, but ghee is often rubbed into the dough and some are served with curd. Vegan only when made with oil.

doodhpak.key_ingredients: Rice, milk, sugar, saffron, cardamom, nuts

dosa.key_ingredients: Fermented rice and urad dal batter, oil, ghee or butter
dosa.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee or butter on the griddle)
dosa.rationale: The batter is plant-based but restaurants commonly cook it in ghee or butter, which a photograph cannot reliably show. Vegan only when made with oil.

double_ka_meetha.key_ingredients: Bread fried in ghee, sweetened reduced milk, saffron, nuts
double_ka_meetha.rationale: Bread fried in ghee and soaked in sweetened milk.

dum_aloo.key_ingredients: Baby potatoes, yoghurt, Kashmiri chilli, fennel, ginger, cream or oil
dum_aloo.rationale: Kashmiri dum aloo is cooked in a yoghurt gravy and Punjabi versions often add cream.

fish_biryani.key_ingredients: Basmati rice, fish or prawns, yoghurt, fried onion, ghee, whole spices
fish_biryani.rationale: Rice layered with fish or prawns.

ghevar.key_ingredients: Refined flour, ghee, milk, sugar syrup, rabri topping, nuts
ghevar.rationale: A ghee-based batter fried into a disc, often topped with rabri.

imarti.key_ingredients: Urad dal batter, sugar syrup, saffron colour, fried in ghee
imarti.rationale: The urad dal batter is plant-based, but imarti is traditionally fried in ghee. Vegan only when fried in oil.

kachori.key_ingredients: Refined flour pastry with ghee or oil shortening, spiced lentil or onion filling, fried
kachori.rationale: The filling is plant-based, but the flaky pastry is often shortened with ghee. Vegan only when made with oil.

kajjikaya.key_ingredients: Refined flour pastry with ghee, coconut or roasted gram, sugar or jaggery, fried
kajjikaya.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee in the pastry, often in the filling)
kajjikaya.rationale: A crescent pastry whose dough and filling usually contain ghee.

kakinada_khaja.key_ingredients: Refined flour, ghee, sugar syrup, fried
kakinada_khaja.rationale: Layered flour dough made with ghee, fried and soaked in syrup.

kalakand.key_ingredients: Milk, chhena or paneer, sugar, cardamom, pistachio
kalakand.rationale: A soft milk-cake made from reduced milk and milk curd.

karela_bharta.key_ingredients: Bitter gourd, onion, green chilli, mustard oil, spices
karela_bharta.rationale: Bitter gourd mashed with onion and mustard oil.

kofta.key_ingredients: Minced meat balls, onion, tomato or yoghurt gravy, spices; some photos show paneer-potato malai kofta
kofta.animal_byproduct: Red meat or poultry (minced); dairy (yoghurt or cream)
kofta.rationale: The dataset class is mostly meat kofta, so it is labelled non-veg; a minority of photos are vegetarian malai kofta, which has its own class.

kuzhi_paniyaram.key_ingredients: Fermented rice and urad dal batter, onion, green chilli, curry leaves, gingelly oil
kuzhi_paniyaram.rationale: Savoury dumplings of idli-dosa batter cooked in oil in a pitted pan, as the photos show. The sweet jaggery version is often cooked in ghee and is not this class.

ledikeni.key_ingredients: Chhena (curdled milk), khoya, flour, fried, sugar syrup
ledikeni.rationale: A fried chhena sweet in syrup, similar to pantua and gulab jamun; the photos show dark fried balls in syrup.

lemon_rice.key_ingredients: Rice, lemon juice, mustard seed, chana and urad dal, peanuts, curry leaves, turmeric, oil
lemon_rice.rationale: Rice tempered in oil and soured with lemon. Some homes temper in ghee, but oil is the usual recipe.

litti_chokha.key_ingredients: Wheat dough balls stuffed with roasted gram flour, dipped in ghee; chokha of roasted aubergine, tomato and potato
litti_chokha.rationale: The litti is traditionally dipped in ghee; the chokha alone is plant-based.

lyangcha.key_ingredients: Chhena (curdled milk), khoya, flour, fried, sugar syrup
lyangcha.rationale: A cylindrical fried chhena sweet in syrup.

maach_jhol.key_ingredients: Fish (rohu or katla), potato, turmeric, cumin, mustard oil

makki_di_roti_sarson_da_saag.key_ingredients: Maize-flour flatbread, mustard greens, spinach, ginger, garlic, ghee or white butter
makki_di_roti_sarson_da_saag.rationale: The saag is tempered in ghee and served with a knob of white butter.
makki_di_roti_sarson_da_saag.local_name: मक्की दी रोटी सरसों दा साग

malapua.key_ingredients: Flour, milk or khoya batter, fried in ghee, sugar syrup, often rabri
malapua.rationale: A milk batter pancake fried in ghee.

misi_roti.key_ingredients: Gram flour, wheat flour, onion, green chilli, spices, ghee
misi_roti.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee in the dough or brushed on)
misi_roti.rationale: The flour is plant-based but misi roti is usually made with ghee in the dough and brushed with ghee. Vegan only when made with oil.

misti_doi.key_ingredients: Milk, caramelised sugar or jaggery, curd culture

modak.key_ingredients: Rice flour dough, coconut and jaggery filling, ghee, cardamom; steamed or fried
modak.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee in the dough and filling)
modak.rationale: Rice, coconut and jaggery are plant-based, but ghee is traditionally added to the dough and filling and served on top. Vegan only when made without ghee.

omelette.key_ingredients: Beaten eggs, onion, green chilli, tomato, coriander, oil or butter
omelette.rationale: An egg dish. Egg counts as non-vegetarian in the Indian convention (FSSAI brown mark), which this taxonomy follows.

payasam.key_ingredients: Rice, vermicelli or lentils, milk or coconut milk, jaggery or sugar, ghee, cashew, raisins
payasam.rationale: Most payasam is cooked in milk, and even coconut-milk versions fry the nuts in ghee.

pesarattu.key_ingredients: Whole green gram batter, ginger, green chilli, onion, oil or ghee
pesarattu.rationale: The green gram batter is plant-based, but like dosa it is often cooked or finished with ghee. Vegan only when made with oil.

phirni.key_ingredients: Ground rice, milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron, nuts
phirni.rationale: Ground rice set in sweetened milk.

pithe.key_ingredients: Rice flour, coconut, jaggery or date-palm jaggery, milk, kheer (khoya) filling
pithe.rationale: A family of Bengali rice-flour sweets; the photos mix patishapta crepes with kheer filling, puli pithe in milk, and fried or steamed pithe. Many contain milk or khoya.

pongal.key_ingredients: Rice, moong dal, black pepper, cumin, ginger, cashew, ghee
pongal.rationale: Ven pongal is cooked and tempered with ghee as standard.

poornalu.key_ingredients: Rice and urad dal batter coating, chana dal and jaggery filling, cardamom, fried; often served with ghee
poornalu.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee in the filling or served with it)
poornalu.rationale: The batter and filling are plant-based, but ghee is often stirred into the filling or poured over when served. Vegan only when made without ghee.

pootharekulu.key_ingredients: Paper-thin rice-starch sheets, powdered sugar or jaggery, ghee, dry fruits
pootharekulu.rationale: Rice-starch sheets layered with sugar and ghee.

prawn_fry.key_ingredients: Prawns, chilli, turmeric, ginger-garlic, curry leaves

qubani_ka_meetha.key_ingredients: Dried apricots, sugar, apricot kernels; served with fresh cream, malai or custard
qubani_ka_meetha.rationale: The apricot compote itself is plant-based but it is normally served topped with cream, malai or custard. Vegan only when served plain.

rabri.key_ingredients: Milk reduced to layers of cream, sugar, cardamom, nuts

rasam.key_ingredients: Tamarind, tomato, black pepper, cumin, garlic, toor dal water, ghee or oil tempering
rasam.rationale: The broth is plant-based, but the tempering is often ghee, which cannot be seen in a photograph. Vegan only when tempered in oil.

rava_kesari.key_ingredients: Semolina, sugar, ghee, saffron, cashew, raisins

sambar.key_ingredients: Toor dal, tamarind, vegetables, sambar powder, mustard seed, curry leaves, oil
sambar.rationale: Lentil and vegetable stew tempered in oil. Plant-based as traditionally made; some kitchens temper in ghee.

sandesh.key_ingredients: Chhena (curdled milk), sugar or date-palm jaggery, cardamom

shankarpali.key_ingredients: Refined flour, ghee, milk, sugar, fried
shankarpali.rationale: The dough is made with ghee and milk.

sheer_korma.key_ingredients: Vermicelli, milk, sugar, dates, ghee, nuts
sheer_korma.rationale: Vermicelli fried in ghee and cooked in milk.

sheera.key_ingredients: Semolina, ghee, sugar, milk or water, cardamom, nuts

sohan_halwa.key_ingredients: Sprouted wheat or flour, milk, sugar, ghee, nuts
sohan_halwa.rationale: A dense halwa cooked with milk and ghee.

sohan_papdi.key_ingredients: Gram flour, refined flour, sugar, ghee, cardamom
sohan_papdi.rationale: Flaky sweet made with flour roasted in ghee.

sutar_feni.key_ingredients: Refined flour or rice flour, ghee, powdered sugar, often eaten with milk
sutar_feni.rationale: Fine threads of dough made with ghee.

tamarind_rice.key_ingredients: Rice, tamarind, sesame oil, peanuts, chana and urad dal, curry leaves, jaggery, spices
tamarind_rice.rationale: Rice tossed with a tamarind paste cooked in sesame oil. Plant-based as traditionally made; some versions temper in ghee.

unni_appam.key_ingredients: Rice flour, banana, jaggery, coconut bits, cardamom, fried in ghee or coconut oil
unni_appam.rationale: The batter is plant-based, but unni appam is traditionally fried in ghee or with coconut bits fried in ghee. Vegan only when fried in coconut oil.

upma.key_ingredients: Semolina, onion, mustard seed, curry leaves, green chilli, oil or ghee
upma.rationale: Semolina and vegetables are plant-based, but upma is often cooked or finished with ghee. Vegan only when made with oil.

uttapam.key_ingredients: Fermented rice and urad dal batter, onion, tomato, chilli, oil, ghee or butter
uttapam.animal_byproduct: Dairy (ghee or butter on the griddle)
uttapam.rationale: The batter and toppings are plant-based, but like dosa it is commonly cooked in ghee or butter. Vegan only when made with oil.
